title: Drift manifest.json
description: Provenance for one snapshot: which commit, which model, which prompt, which judge. Written by `drift snapshot` alongside results.json, one per snapshot directory.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this manifest schema. Drift accepts any 1.x file.

commit_hash.description: Full 40-character git commit hash the snapshot belongs to, from `git rev-parse HEAD`. Also the snapshot directory name, so it is immutable once written.

created_at.description: When the snapshot was written, ISO 8601 with an explicit UTC offset. Distinct from the per-case `timestamp`: results may have been produced well before they were snapshotted.

model_version.description: Free text: whatever the team's harness reports for the model under test (e.g. `claude-opus-5`, `gpt-4o-2024-08-06`, an internal build tag).

prompt_version.description: Free text: version or hash of the prompt/agent configuration under test.

judge_version.description: Free text: version or hash of the scoring rubric / judge used to produce metric_scores. REQUIRED even if it is only a placeholder such as `unset`. `drift diff` compares this field between the two snapshots: when it differs, scores were produced by different graders and Fixed/Regressed claims are not directly comparable.

drift_version.description: Version of the getdrift package that wrote the snapshot. Informational.

case_count.description: Number of case entries in the sibling results.json. Informational; a cheap integrity check.

metadata.description: Free-form snapshot-level metadata (CI run URL, branch name, dataset revision, ...). Drift never reads it.
